name: Convert assignments from structural connectivity to wmc datatype
summary: Converts structural connectivity streamline assignments (streamline-to-node-pair labels) into a white matter classification (wmc) with one tract per connected region pair, using DIPY and pandas.
description: Reads the per-streamline node-pair assignments and the parcellation labels, names each pair as track_<region>_to_<region>, builds a wmc classification and tract files from the tractogram, and generates surface meshes of the parcellation regions for visualisation. Use it to view or analyse the streamlines behind individual connectome edges; the tractogram and parcellation must be the ones used to compute the assignments.

inputs.description: Streamline-to-node-pair assignments from a structural connectivity App (index and pair names).
DWI used as the reference space when loading the tractogram.
Parcellation (with label.json) whose regions define the connectome nodes.

outputs.description: White matter classification with one tract per connected region pair, plus tract and region surface files.

failure_modes.fix: Check that the assignments, tractogram and parcellation come from the same connectivity run.
